title: Incompatible schema major: worker advertises major 2, job requires major 1
description: Worker registers with schemaMajor=2 but the job envelope requires schemaMajor=1. The dispatcher must withhold the job offer because the schema major versions are incompatible.
notes: Job must be withheld when worker schema major does not match required schema major. Worker registration itself is accepted; only job dispatch is blocked.
